exposure: Mild maternal thrombocytopenia prior to cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered via cesarean section at two tertiary medical centers in Korea between January 2009 and December 2019.
finding: Mild maternal thrombocytopenia before cesarean section was associated with a threefold higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage, and increased likelihood of requiring blood transfusions and experiencing a >4 g/dL drop in hemoglobin level.
